item.title: SASSA Older Persons Grant 2026: R2,400 Amount, Payment Dates and eLife
item.description: The SASSA Older Persons Grant is R2,400 a month (R2,420 if you are 75 or older) from April 2026. Payment dates, the 2026 means test, eLife certification and how to apply.

item.title: SASSA SRD Grant June 2026: Still R370, Extended to March 2027
item.description: The SRD grant stays at R370 for June 2026 — no increase from the 2026 Budget, but extended to March 2027. Payment dates, eligibility, and how to check your status.

item.title: How to Get Your SRD R370 Grant Paid in 2026: Bank, Cash Send or Postbank
item.description: The ways your SRD R370 grant can be paid in 2026: your own bank account, a cash send code you withdraw at an ATM, or a Postbank card. How to change your details safely.

item.title: SASSA Grant Requirements 2026/27: Eligibility and Amounts for Every Grant
item.description: Every SASSA grant for 2026/27 in one place: the new amounts from April 2026, who qualifies, the means test and the documents you need to apply.
